## Revision and part

Give the repository revision, native/export filename and affected interface.

## Setup

List the actual component or fastener, printer/nozzle, material, layer height, orientation and relevant compensation. State whether the part was modified after printing.

## Observation

Explain the expected and actual fit. Attach measurements with instrument resolution and clear photographs when available. Record failures as well as successful variants.

## Suggested next step

Describe a proposed dimension or test change, if known. Separate observations from explanations that still need testing.
